scientific_integrity: The common-age mixture and free-gas Rayleigh limit are credited as existing results; the new claim is the strictly confining subquadratic extension and collapse of the proposed normalization. Numerical checks are not used to prove limits.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive parameters, one-time stationary maximum, strict 1<alpha<2. No uniform-in-age estimate or finite-N rate; the alpha=2 and superquadratic regimes are excluded. Priority is best-knowledge and not independently certified.
title: Rayleigh extremes persist under subquadratic confinement in a collectively reset Brownian gas
